intro: Myanmar stretches from Himalayan peaks in the north to tropical islands in the south, with the Irrawaddy river at its heart.

chapters.title: River and mountains
text: The Irrawaddy flows over 2,000 km through the centre to a huge rice-growing delta. Hkakabo Razi, about 5,880 m, in the far north is the highest peak in Southeast Asia.
Mountains along the borders with India, China and Thailand are home to many ethnic groups.

chapters.title: Monsoon
text: The monsoon brings heavy rain from May to October; the central dry zone is much drier. Cyclone Nargis in 2008 killed over 130,000 people.

keyTerms.meaning: Flat land where a river splits before the sea.
